sentences.text: The International Space Station -LRB- ISS -RRB- is a space station , or a habitable artificial satellite , in low Earth orbit .	space station	space station	artificial satellite	satellite	low Earth orbit	low Earth orbit

Its first component launched into orbit in 1998 , and the ISS is now the largest man-made body in low Earth orbit and can often be seen with the naked eye from Earth .	low Earth orbit	low Earth orbit	naked eye	naked eye
The ISS consists of pressurised modules , external trusses , solar arrays , and other components .	solar arrays	solar arrays
ISS components have been launched by Russian Proton and Soyuz rockets , and American Space Shuttles .	Proton	Proton (rocket family)	Soyuz	Soyuz (spacecraft)

The ISS serves as a microgravity and space environment research laboratory in which crew members conduct experiments in biology , human biology , physics , astronomy , meteorology , and other fields .	microgravity	microgravity	space environment	space environment	biology	biology	human biology	human biology	physics	physics	astronomy	astronomy	meteorology	meteorology	other fields	Scientific research on the International Space Station
The station is suited for the testing of spacecraft systems and equipment required for missions to the Moon and Mars .

The ISS maintains an orbit with an altitude of between 330 and by means of reboost manoeuvres using the engines of the Zvezda module or visiting spacecraft .	maintains an orbit with an altitude	Orbital station-keeping	Zvezda	Zvezda (ISS module)
It completes orbits per day .

The ISS is the ninth space station to be inhabited by crews , following the Soviet and later Russian Salyut , Almaz , and Mir stations as well as Skylab from the US .	space station	space station	Salyut	Salyut programme	Almaz	Almaz	Mir	Mir	Skylab	Skylab
The station has been continuously occupied for since the arrival of Expedition 1 on 2 November 2000 .	Expedition 1	Expedition 1
This is the longest continuous human presence in low Earth orbit , having surpassed the previous record of held by Mir .	low Earth orbit	low Earth orbit	Mir	Mir

The station is serviced by a variety of visiting spacecraft : the Russian Soyuz and Progress , the American Dragon and Cygnus , the Japanese H-II Transfer Vehicle , and formerly the Space Shuttle and the European Automated Transfer Vehicle .	Soyuz	Soyuz (spacecraft)	Space Shuttle	Space Shuttle	Progress	Progress (spacecraft)	Dragon	SpaceX Dragon	Cygnus	Cygnus (spacecraft)	H-II Transfer Vehicle	H-II Transfer Vehicle	Automated Transfer Vehicle	Automated Transfer Vehicle
It has been visited by astronauts , cosmonauts and space tourists from 17 different nations .	17 different nations	List of International Space Station visitors

After the US Space Shuttle programme ended in 2011 , Soyuz rockets became the only provider of transport for astronauts at the International Space Station , and Dragon became the only provider of bulk cargo return to Earth -LRB- called downmass -RRB- .	Soyuz	Soyuz (spacecraft)	Space Shuttle	Space Shuttle	Dragon	SpaceX Dragon	downmass	downmass
Soyuz has very limited downmass capability .	Soyuz	Soyuz (spacecraft)	downmass	downmass

The ISS programme is a joint project among five participating space agencies : NASA , Roscosmos , JAXA , ESA , and CSA .	ISS programme	International Space Station program	NASA	NASA	Roscosmos	Roscosmos State Corporation	JAXA	JAXA	ESA	European Space Agency	CSA	Canadian Space Agency
The ownership and use of the space station is established by intergovernmental treaties and agreements .	space station	space station

The station is divided into two sections , the Russian Orbital Segment -LRB- ROS -RRB- and the United States Orbital Segment -LRB- USOS -RRB- , which is shared by many nations .	Russian Orbital Segment	Russian Orbital Segment	United States Orbital Segment	US Orbital Segment
, the American portion of ISS is being funded until 2024 .

Roscosmos has endorsed the continued operation of ISS through 2024 but has proposed using elements of the Russian Orbital Segment to construct a new Russian space station called OPSEK .	space station	space station	Roscosmos	Roscosmos State Corporation	Russian Orbital Segment	Russian Orbital Segment	OPSEK	Orbital Piloted Assembly and Experiment Complex

On 28 March 2015 , Russian sources announced that Roscosmos and NASA had agreed to collaborate on the development of a replacement for the current ISS .	NASA	NASA	Roscosmos	Roscosmos State Corporation
NASA later issued a guarded statement expressing thanks for Russia 's interest in future co-operation in space exploration but fell short of confirming the Russian announcement .	NASA	NASA
